name: HitGen Inc.
summary: HitGen Inc. operates as a drug discovery research platform for small molecules and nucleic acid drugs in China and internationally. Its technology platform includes DNA-encoded library technology; fragment-based drug discovery and structure-based drug design technologies; virtual screening; emerging technology platforms for synthetic therapeutic oligonucleotide technology; and targeted protein degradation technology.
